state:
**Goal `performance-pass`, Stage 2 (the growth tool).** `bun nv scaling` in `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts` measures four ladder kinds — `run`, `compile`, `lsp`, `fmt` — each a `Measure` there; the module doc says what each one measures and is the home of the ramp, the bounds, `EXPECT`, `KINDS` and `AREAS`. Tests: `tools/nv/test/scaling.test.ts`. Only `serve` is not measured yet; a `serve` ladder is reported invalid.

**`lsp`** drives `nvs lsp` over stdio with no root (`lspScript`, `LspReader`, `lspSession`): open, edit, then completion, hover and references at the `<|>` the printed document marks, timed from the open to the last answer. Callgrind pipes the same frames in from a `.lspin` file beside the copy (`lspInstructions`); that path has not run yet.

**`nvs check --count`** prints `compile: tokens= nodes= names= exprs=` on stderr, and `nvs run --count` adds `ir=` (`Checked::count_line` in `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs`).

**`--iterations --check`** is not reliable yet: counts are the same on every run, and a bench whose counts settled but whose clock grew twice now goes to callgrind. No full sweep has run since that change.

**Ladders:** `arrays/sort.nvs` (run, flat), `compiler/functions.nvs` (compile, flat), `fmt/classes.nvs` (fmt, **grows**, about 4x to 5x per doubling), `lsp/classes.nvs` (lsp, **grows**: clock slope 1.91 and 1.98 on the debug build; every step of the session is superlinear, `nvs check` on the same document is linear; written in `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` § *What we found*). So `--check` fails on two ladders, and `--areas` names 18 of 22 areas without one. `docs/perf/performance-review.md` does not exist yet (Stage 4).

items.text: **The `serve` kind** — `nvs serve` on a free port with a load the tool sends; per-request counts and peak memory, flat per request (goal prose Stage 2, *The bounds*). Dispatch at `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:1593`; `bun nv bench` already loads a server in `tools/nv/cmd/bench.ts:1161` (`measureServer`), reuse its peer rather than writing a second client. Add `serve` to `MEASURED_KINDS` at `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:243`. Rule: `rule:testing/bench-counters`.

**A `request` ladder** under `benches/scaling/request/` once `serve` measures, closing that area for `--areas` (`missingAreas` at `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:682`). Rule: `rule:testing/bench-counters`; shape `benches/scaling/README.md`.

backlog: **`nvs lsp` is quadratic** in document size (`benches/scaling/lsp/classes.nvs`). Hover alone goes 228 ms to 1189 ms from 800 to 1600 classes on the debug build, so the cost is shared per request, not only in publishing diagnostics. Start in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/server.rs` (`answer`, `reanalyse`) and the position conversion in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/position.rs`. Stage 5 fix; owner doc `docs/perf/performance-pass.md`.

**`nvs fmt` is quadratic** in file size (`benches/scaling/fmt/classes.nvs`). `print::print` in `crates/nvs-fmt/src/print.rs:67` is linear; the cause is in one of the stages it calls (`indent`, `brace`, `space`, `tokens`, `modifiers`, `imports`). Stage 5 fix; owner doc `docs/perf/performance-pass.md`.
Stage 3: a ladder for each of the 18 areas `bun nv scaling --areas` names.
